sections.title: Space and Aerospace Systems ML
sections.description: For Lockheed Martin Space (Littleton CO), ULA (Centennial CO), and Denver's world-class Space Corridor.

blocks.heading: Satellite health and anomaly detection
paragraphs: ML for monitoring the health of satellite systems — detecting telemetry anomalies that indicate component degradation or operational issues in the commercial and government satellite programs managed from Lockheed's Littleton campus. Satellite anomaly detection must be highly sensitive (missing an early anomaly leads to mission loss) and highly specific (false positives generate unnecessary operations team interventions).

blocks.heading: Orbital mechanics and maneuver optimization
paragraphs: ML for spacecraft trajectory and maneuver optimization — predicting fuel-optimal maneuver sequences for the satellite constellation management programs that increasingly require ML for the large numbers of satellites in low Earth orbit that human operators cannot manage individually.

blocks.heading: Supply chain risk for aerospace programs
paragraphs: ML for the complex aerospace supply chain risk analytics that the Space Corridor's programs require — long-lead-time components, sole-source suppliers, and the geopolitical supply chain risks that space program procurement must navigate.
Self-hosted on corporate infrastructure for all classified-adjacent applications.

sections.title: Energy Grid and Renewable ML (Xcel Energy)
sections.description: Xcel Energy (Denver HQ) — one of the US's largest utilities, with ambitious renewable energy commitments in Colorado.

blocks.heading: Solar and wind generation forecasting
paragraphs: ML for Xcel's rapidly growing renewable energy portfolio in Colorado — the Front Range's Chinook wind patterns, afternoon thunderstorm season, and the specific solar irradiance patterns of Colorado's high-altitude geography create generation forecasting challenges that require Colorado-specific model calibration.

blocks.heading: Grid outage and reliability ML
paragraphs: ML for Xcel's transmission and distribution reliability analytics — predicting outage probability from equipment age, vegetation management cycles, and weather patterns for the Colorado distribution network that serves both dense urban and rural mountain geographies.

blocks.heading: Colorado clean energy transition analytics
paragraphs: ML for the regulatory and investment planning analytics of Xcel's aggressive decarbonization commitment — the resource mix optimization, storage requirement modeling, and transmission infrastructure planning that a 100% clean energy transition requires.

sections.title: Healthcare Clinical ML
sections.description: For UCHealth, CommonSpirit Colorado, and Denver's health systems.

blocks.heading: Altitude-adjusted clinical prediction models
paragraphs: ML calibrated to Denver's 5,280-foot elevation — ClickMasters incorporates the altitude-specific physiological adjustments (hemoglobin distribution, oxygen saturation norms, pulmonary arterial pressure baselines) that the University of Colorado's altitude medicine research has quantified, and that sea-level-calibrated national models miss.

blocks.heading: Colorado AI Act-compliant clinical ML
paragraphs: Denver healthcare ML must comply with SB24-205's requirements for high-risk automated decision systems — impact assessment, consumer disclosure, and ongoing monitoring for all clinical ML meeting the Colorado AI Act's high-risk threshold.

sections.title: Cannabis Industry Analytics
sections.description: Colorado's mature legal cannabis market — the most developed cannabis analytics market in the US.

blocks.heading: Cannabis retail demand analytics
paragraphs: ML for Colorado's licensed cannabis dispensaries — predicting product demand across the complex cross-product, cross-potency cannabis product portfolio, accounting for the seasonal tourism patterns that bring non-Colorado cannabis consumers into the market.

blocks.heading: Cannabis regulatory compliance ML
paragraphs: ML for the seed-to-sale compliance tracking and Colorado MED reporting analytics that Colorado's licensed cannabis industry requires — the Metrc-integrated data creates ML opportunities for operational efficiency and compliance management.

sections.title: Colorado AI Act compliance across all Denver ML
sections.description: Colorado SB24-205 requires impact assessment for high-risk automated decision systems.

blocks.heading: SB24-205 scope for ML
paragraphs: Any ML system that makes consequential decisions about Colorado consumers — in healthcare, credit, housing, insurance, and employment — must meet Colorado AI Act requirements. ClickMasters includes CO AI Act impact assessment as a standard deliverable for any Denver ML that may meet the high-risk threshold, rather than assessing applicability only after a model is built.
